sourceRefs.locator: II.37. Passage through Touraine, hay taken from a poor man, defeat and death of Alaric and the losses among men from the Auvergne.
pp. 43–47 and 56–61. Distance from Poitiers in Gregory’s narrative, Vouillé and Voulon among the proposed battle locations.

note.de: Der zehnte Meilenstein lässt mehrere Lokalisierungen zu. Beide Kapitel verwenden dieselbe Umrissfläche für diese Unsicherheit.
note.en: The tenth milestone admits several possible locations. Both chapters use the same outline for this uncertainty.

note.de: Chlodwig stand 507 Alarich II. in der Gegend von Poitiers gegenüber.
note.en: Clovis faced Alaric II near Poitiers in 507.
